_comment: Site-only lore/bio text for the marketing pages, not part of the game's catalog.json source of truth. Source: Stefan's Rise of Monsters spreadsheet (Heroes/Monsters tabs, Oct 24 2025), relayed by Hill 2026-11-03.

Rhukosk.bio: A stoic swamp tracker, Rhukosk is patient and precise, striking from afar while toxins do the rest.
Rhukosk.art: Rhukosk draws his barbed longbow with calm precision, wading through tall swampgrass as he takes aim at a distant beast.

Alruzzi.bio: A cunning hunter of the wetlands, Alruzzi blends stealth and venom to wear down even the mightiest foes.
Alruzzi.art: Alruzzi charges low through the reeds, twin blades flashing with venom as her tail cuts a wake in the golden grass.

Klubain.bio: Mischievous and ingenious, Klubain is a scrappy rogue who turns every encounter into an opportunity.
Klubain.art: Klubain ducks beneath a monster's swing, flashing a grin as he slides in and jabs with his hidden dagger before vanishing into shadow.

Ussawei.bio: Quick-witted and sly, Ussawei lets her blade do the talking while her nimble fingers steal the show.
Ussawei.art: Ussawei cartwheels around her foe, striking with sharp precision before fading into the brush with a smirk and a wink.

Verthok.bio: A battlefield juggernaut, Verthok's fury is legendary; his axe carves paths few enemies survive.
Verthok.art: Verthok roars mid-leap, great axe raised high as he slams into his enemy with the earthshaking force of a berserker.

Marzul.bio: A warborn chieftain, Marzul commands brute strength and bloodlust in equal measure.
Marzul.art: Marzul storms forward, her blade already swinging in an arc meant to cleave through shields, banners, and bone alike.

Bael.bio: A mountain guardian through and through, Bael's shield is as unyielding as the granite he calls home.
Bael.art: Bael stands like a mountain, deflecting a blow with his hammer before countering with a shield slam that sends shockwaves through the ground.

Thevra.bio: Thevra stands unbroken against the storm: unyielding, proud, and fiercely protective of her kin.
Thevra.art: Thevra braces with a calm exhale, hammer glowing faintly as she channels the strength of the stone beneath her feet to guard her allies.

Sokur.bio: A shadow-wielding mystic, Sokur bends dark forces to shield his allies and devastate his foes.
Sokur.art: Sokur twists his staff in a dark arc, pulling tendrils of shadow through the air before hurling them forward in a withering blast.

Khivris.bio: Silent and sharp as moonlight on glass, Khivris channels the shadows with haunting precision.
Khivris.art: Khivris glides across the battlefield with unnatural grace, her staff lashing in a crescent arc as magic pulses beneath her fingertips.

Zeke.bio: A steadfast swordsman and natural leader, Zeke strikes with precision and elemental fury.
Zeke.art: Zeke deflects a monster's claw with his sword, spins, and strikes with a fiery riposte, cape whipping behind him like a banner of war.

Evalynn.bio: Evalynn wields both blade and flame with grace; her calm demeanor conceals the fire within.
Evalynn.art: Evalynn blazes through the battlefield, her flaming sword sweeping in arcs of heat and fury as enemies fall around her.

monsters.Ashuraz the Demon Djin: A twisted fire spirit who grants wishes that always come at a horrifying cost. Ashuraz speaks in riddles and thrives on manipulation, reshaping fate through flame and deceit. Summoned only by the reckless, or the doomed.
monsters.Varneth, the Coil Tyrant: A massive scaled beast that slithers through ancient ruins with silent grace. Its hypnotic gaze paralyzes prey before coiling tightly around them. Whispers say it once guarded a long-lost empire beneath the sands.
monsters.Wooly Dire Wolf: A savage predator of the frozen wilds, its frost-tipped fur camouflages it in snowy terrain. Red eyes glow in the dark, and its howl is enough to freeze the blood of any wanderer.
monsters.Grallok the Broken (Tortured Owlbear): A monstrous fusion of bear and owl, warped by cruel experimentation. Its pained screech echoes through the woods. Scarred and stitched, it charges with fury, craving vengeance for the abomination it has become.
monsters.Zahir the Bound (Warrior Genie): A noble elemental warrior bound in golden chains, called forth from the Elemental Plane of Air. With every strike, it edges closer to freedom, fighting with both elegance and desperation.
monsters.Voltusk: Born from a thunderbolt that struck a sacred mountain, Voltusk is speed and chaos embodied. Its crackling fur glows with static charge, and its bite can knock foes unconscious. Hunters say it disappears in a flash and returns with thunder.
monsters.The Riddlefang (Guardian Sphinx): An ancient protector of forbidden knowledge, carved by the gods and animated by riddles. Its wings blot the sun, and its judgment is final: fail its question, and feel the sting of divine claws.
monsters.Gorath the Destroyer: A fallen titan clad in obsidian armor, wielding a colossal flaming axe. Every step it takes cracks the earth beneath it. His wrath is as heavy as the mountains he once ruled.
monsters.Mortag the Maligned: Banished by a conclave of mages, Mortag returned from the grave as a lich. His cursed winds shred the will of his enemies, while skeletal spirits whisper their madness through the fog.
monsters.Velkash the Venom Queen (Tortured Scorpi: A once-proud ruler twisted by venom and spite. Her cracked carapace drips with acid, and her venomous crown pierces any who draw near. She commands a brood of pain and poison.
monsters.Slorrg of the Mire (Infested Bog Troll): A towering brute teeming with rot and parasites. His bloated form leaks swamp filth with every step. He spreads decay not just with his club, but with every breath and wound.
monsters.Volmir the Skyflame (Enraged Wyvern): A skyborne terror of claw and flame. Its twin wings serve as both limbs and weapons, and its mind burns with blind rage. When it dives, nothing survives the impact.
monsters.Aesmelia the Siren Queen (Ancient Siren): A timeless spirit whose beauty conceals a heart of cruelty. Her voice charms even monsters, drawing them into illusions and madness. Her waters are graveyards of those who dared to listen.
monsters.Rhaskhul the Scarred (Terrasque): A near-unstoppable juggernaut with armor like mountains and eyes filled with endless rage. Its body is marked with scars from ancient wars, and yet none have ever brought it down.
monsters.Ignarok, Flame of the Deep (Fire Giant): A blazing juggernaut born from the molten core of the world. It lives only for conquest and incineration, a walking inferno wielding fire as an extension of its will.
monsters.Vaelstorm the Skyfather (Storm Dragon): A divine beast born from lightning and hurricane winds. It soars above the clouds, calling storms to its aid. Entire fleets have vanished beneath its roar.

world._comment: Verbatim/condensed from Rise-of-Monsters-Story.md, the Story doc Stefan shared via Hill 2026-11-03 (attachment eca670a3-a5d6-406c-9e6e-75a5b8d690e8). Not invented.

stages.heading: The clans were constantly at war.
stages.text: The world was in constant turmoil, clan against clan, until an ominous, powerful darkness descended upon the land.

stages.heading: Monsters nearly destroyed the world.
stages.text: Emerging from the horizon came monsters that nearly destroyed the world and all its people.

stages.heading: Great heroes banded together.
stages.text: By some miracle, great heroes emerged from the separate clans and united to face the onslaught of terror that threatened their very existence.

stages.heading: The Shadow Amulet was shattered.
stages.text: The source of the darkness was the Shadow Amulet, a relic that could command and empower monsters. United by necessity, the clans shattered it into pieces to splinter its power and hide its dark influence.

stages.heading: An era of harmony.
stages.text: Through great effort and sacrifice, the mighty warriors forced the monsters to retreat. The world enjoyed an era of harmony, and in time the amulet's true nature was lost to memory.

stages.heading: One piece has awakened.
stages.text: Eons have passed. Something dark and foreboding is stirring again. One shattered piece of the Shadow Amulet has awakened, and the monsters have begun to reemerge. As each round progresses, more pieces stir, bringing greater threats.

stages.heading: The rift tears open.
stages.text: Where the fragment woke, the ground itself splinters. A rift fractures open between worlds, and the first monsters emerge through it into the realm.

stages.heading: Are there any heroes left?
stages.text: The clans must band together once more to survive and beat back the monsters, hoping to quell the evil and uncover why the amulet has awakened at all.
